slides.title: Patterns are promises
slides.text: A pattern is a promise about what comes next. Break the promise and the pattern stops working. Keep it, and you can predict far ahead.

visual.label: An add-5 pattern: 4, 9, 14, 19, and what comes next?

focus.cue: 4, 9, 14: each tile adds 5, just as promised.
The promise says what comes next: 24.

slides.title: The Jumble swaps a tile
slides.text: The Counting House tiles read 4, 9, 14, 20, 24. One tile breaks the add-5 promise. The Jumble swapped it. The tile should be 19, not 20.

focus.cue: 4, 9, 14: each tile adds 5, just as promised.
This tile should be 19. The Jumble swapped it for 20.

slides.title: Predict the tenth tile
slides.text: Rough first: adding 5 ten times adds about 50. Follow the promise from 3, step by step.
steps: start at 3, the rule is add 5

visual.label: Add-5 pattern from 3 to the tenth tile, 48

focus.cue: Start at 3. The rule is add 5, every time.

slides.title: Stretch: Even plus even
slides.text: Add any two even numbers and the answer is always even. Odd plus odd is even too. Patterns hide inside the tables, waiting to be spotted.

visual.label: Even plus even is even, and odd plus odd is even too

focus.cue: Even plus even: 2 + 4 = 6, an even answer.
Odd plus odd is even too: 3 + 5 = 8.

words.means: a set of numbers or shapes that follows a rule
the promise a pattern keeps, like add 5
to say what comes next, using the rule
a number that pairs up with nothing left over

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Quest Race and finish one whole Practice Race, all the way to the podium. It opens straight on pattern questions, with no picking first. Call out the rule of each pattern before you answer, every single time.
